source: Robert's direct estimating and programme walkthrough feedback,18October2026, including follow-up advanced-blue comment
status: Record-only until explicit release. Estimating and programme are core product capabilities requiring substantive rethink, not cosmetic tweaks.

estimating.requirement: Professional line-item tabular estimating, comparable in usefulness to Candy/Excel build-ups. Robust detail for contractors, not serial one-word forms or oversimplified consumer workflow.
estimating.desktop: Use desktop width meaningfully; current narrow central layout and large margins waste workspace. User estimates about40% width, not instrumented geometry proof.

programmePresentation.problem: Black backdrop/green block, blue sidebar and duplicate top navigation inconsistent with brand; advanced planner reverts to blue as well.
programmePresentation.gantt: Redesign clean readable baseline/proposal mini-Gantt and professional detailed planner. Use restrained purposeful colour/shading for activities and proposal diagrams; this is not approval for arbitrary blue UI chrome.
programmePresentation.weekends: User dislikes gaps and weekend presentation making sequential weeks look disconnected. Review display of calendar span/non-working days clearly. Do not infer all jobs must work7days or change actual working-week policy without explicit design.
programmePresentation.save: User initially could not find Save programme, then found it; improve discoverability. Do not add autosave or alter save semantics implicitly.

reportedMismatch.baseline: Attached simple preview: demo19-23Oct, Install26-30Oct, Finishing works2-6Nov2026,1weekeach,summary3weeks/finish6Nov.
reportedMismatch.detailed: Attached detailed planner: working week5d, each task5d, dates19-26Oct/26Oct-2Nov/2-9Nov,summary21d/4calendarweeks/completion9Nov. Inputstart18Oct,normalisedMonday19Oct.
reportedMismatch.visual: User reports bar positions do not align with week/day grid and duration. Treat screenshot-supported baseline/planner inconsistency and alignment as verification targets, not resolved arithmetic diagnosis.
reportedMismatch.currentDOM: Same detailed summary/three5drows observed in live DOM. Existing explanatory copy distinguishes whole-week grid and working-day proposal dates; explanatory copy is not acceptance or resolution.
reportedMismatch.bounds: Investigate actual calendar/date mapping, bar scale/position/width, inclusive/exclusive finish and rounding after tour. No silent date/workweek/duration normalisation or assertion suppression.

capability.positive: Detailed planner first impression somewhat better, and Regenerate from estimate concept useful.
capability.bar: Aim for credible planning capability; P6/Primavera, Microsoft Project and Asta named as research references, not literal engineering-heavy UI or feature-parity acceptance.
capability.AI: Contextual assistant should identify and discuss key milestones, procurement lead times and client-supplied requirements/decisions alongside activities. Suggestions must be reviewed; no invented commitments/provider activation.

execution: Human reports entering demo/install/finishing stages and locating Save. Agent did not edit/save/auto-sequence/regenerate/drag or activate detailed planner. Agent observed planner already open, then used existing Proposals link at request. No assertion about backend writes from human interactions. No implementation/tests/diagnostics.
